title: Fixing a product coordinate
statement: Let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\mathbb{R}$, choose $j\in\mathrm{Fin}\ n$, and fix $\omega\in\Omega$. The function obtained by fixing coordinate $j$ to $\omega$ sends each input $x$ to $f$ evaluated at the input with its $j$th coordinate replaced by $\omega$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega$
